_A_DATE_INPUT_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ADateInput is a text field for a date, a date with time or a time, also as a range (from – to). The date is typed in the format of the language or chosen in a calendar. The model is an ISO string ("2025-03-05", "2025-03-05T14:30", "14:30"), with range an array [start, end]. The component is new in 3.x and an accessible alternative to ADatepicker.
_A_DATE_INPUT_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_:
Accessibility:

  • Typing is the main way: a normal text field with a label and a visible format ("Format: DD.MM.YYYY") that is also read by the screen reader. Short inputs are understood: 5.3.25, 050325, 2025-03-05, 5.3 (current year); times as 14:30, 1430, 9 or 2:30 pm.
  • A wrong date does not disappear: the text stays, the field gets aria-invalid and an error with an example, connected with aria-describedby.
  • The calendar button says which date is selected. The calendar is a modal dialog with a grid (WAI-ARIA date picker dialog): ← → day, ↑ ↓ week, Home End start and end of the week, Page Up Page Down month, with Shift year, Enter or Space selects, Escape closes. The focus stays in the dialog and goes back to the button. The month is announced.
  • Every day is read with the full date; today has aria-current="date", the selected day aria-selected, days that cannot be chosen aria-disabled.
  • Several fields (range, date and time) are in a group with the label of the component, every field has its own visible label.
  • The button next to the heading of the calendar goes to the months and the years; a month or a year opens the days of it again. The quick choice buttons are a group with a name, the clear button says which field it empties.
  • Week numbers are row headers, two months are two grids with the name of the month. The period under the mouse is only a visual help; the chosen dates are said by the buttons and the fields. The button "Today" is disabled when today cannot be chosen.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK_DE: First day of the week in the calendar: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_IS_DATE_DISABLED_DES: Function (isoDate) => Boolean: days that cannot be chosen, e.g. weekends. The date is "YYYY-MM-DD". With "month" it gets "YYYY-MM", with "year" "YYYY".
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_LOCALE_DESCRIPTION_: Language of the format and of the calendar, e.g. "en-US". By default the current language of the translations.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MAX_DESCRIPTION_: Latest date "YYYY-MM-DD". With "month" and "year" also "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MIN_DESCRIPTION_: Earliest date "YYYY-MM-DD". With "month" and "year" also "YYYY-MM" or "YYYY".
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MODE_DESCRIPTION_: "date", "datetime" (a date and a time field) or "time" (without calendar). "month" ("YYYY-MM") and "year" ("YYYY") give a calendar of months or years. "week": an ISO week "2025-W10".
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_DESCRIPT: ISO string: "2025-03-05", "2025-03-05T14:30", "14:30". With range an array [start, end]. A wrong or incomplete input gives null. With model-format also a timestamp, a Date or an own format.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_RANGE_DESCRIPTION_: Two values: from and to. The end must not be before the start.
_A_DATE_INPUT_METHODS_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: Sets the focus to the first field.
_A_DATE_INPUT_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Type a date, e.g. 17.5.90, and leave the field, or choose it in the calendar. The text is shown in the full format afterwards.
_A_DATE_INPUT_LIMITS_DESCRIPTION_: min and max limit the dates, is-date-disabled disables single days, here weekends. These days are marked in the calendar and give an error when typed.
_A_DATE_INPUT_TIME_DESCRIPTION_: mode="datetime" shows a date and a time field, the model is "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm". mode="time" is only a time field.
_A_DATE_INPUT_RANGE_DESCRIPTION_: With range there are two fields "From" and "To", each with its own calendar; the calendar shows the range. With mode="datetime" there are four fields. default-time fills the empty time, here ["00:00", "23:59"].
_A_DATE_INPUT_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm the element has the type dateInput.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_CLEARABLE_DESCRIPTIO: Shows a button in every field that empties it. Its name is "Clear …" with the label of the field; after a click the focus is in the field.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_DEFAULT_TIME_DESCRIP: Time for a date without time, "HH:mm" or with range ["00:00", "23:59"]. Only with mode="datetime".
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_SHORTCUTS_DESCRIPTIO: Buttons in the calendar: [{ label, value }]. value is a model (a string or [start, end]) or a function that returns it. The value is checked like a typed one.
_A_DATE_INPUT_SLOTS_DAY_DESCRIPTION_: Own content in a day of the calendar, e.g. a mark for holidays. Slot props: date ("YYYY-MM-DD"), day, isDisabled, isOtherMonth, isSelected, isToday. The full date stays the name of the day; give a mark a text for screen readers (a_sr_only).
_A_DATE_INPUT_SHORTCUTS_DESCRIPTION_: shortcuts adds buttons to the calendar, here for periods; a function calculates the dates when it is clicked. clearable adds a button that empties a field.
_A_DATE_INPUT_MONTH_DESCRIPTION_: mode="month" gives the model "YYYY-MM" and a calendar of months, mode="year" the model "YYYY" and a calendar of years.
_A_DATE_INPUT_SLOT_DESCRIPTION_: The slot day adds content to a day, here a mark for holidays with a text for screen readers.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MAX_DAYS_DESCRIPTION: Range of days: the end minus the start in days at most (01.03. – 03.03. = 2).
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MIN_DAYS_DESCRIPTION: Range of days: the end minus the start in days at least.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MINUTE_STEP_DESCRIPT: Only every n minutes, e.g. 15. Another time gives an error with the nearest allowed time.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MODEL_FORMAT_DESCRIP: Form of the model: "iso" (default), "timestamp" (milliseconds), "date" (a Date object) or tokens YYYY MM DD HH mm ss, e.g. "DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm". The fields always show the format of the language.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_MONTHS_DESCRIPTION_: 1 or 2 months side by side in the calendar.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_SHOW_TODAY_DESCRIPTI: A button "Today" in the calendar. It is disabled when today cannot be chosen.
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_SHOW_WEEK_NUMBERS_DE: A column with the ISO week numbers in the calendar (always with mode="week").
_A_DATE_INPUT_PROPS_UTC_DESCRIPTION_: With mode="datetime": the model is a moment in UTC ("2025-03-05T13:30:00Z"), the fields show the local time.
_A_DATE_INPUT_EVENTS_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: The calendar was opened. Argument: { index } (0 the start, 1 the end).
_A_DATE_INPUT_EVENTS_CLOSE_DESCRIPTION_: The calendar was closed. Argument: { index }.
_A_DATE_INPUT_METHODS_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: Opens the calendar, index 1 is the end of a range. The focus goes into the calendar.
_A_DATE_INPUT_TIME_RULES_DESCRIPTION_: :minute-step="15", min-time="08:00" and max-time="18:00" allow only quarter hours during the working day. with-seconds adds the seconds.
_A_DATE_INPUT_BOOKING_DESCRIPTION_: :months="2" shows two months, :min-days="1" and :max-days="14" limit the length of the stay, show-today and show-week-numbers add a button and the weeks. Moving the mouse shows the period before the click.
_A_DATE_INPUT_WEEK_DESCRIPTION_: mode="week": the model is an ISO week ("2025-W10"), a day in the calendar chooses its week.
_A_DATE_INPUT_MODEL_FORMAT_DESCRIPTION_: utc saves a moment in UTC, model-format saves "DD.MM.YYYY" or a timestamp. The fields are the same.
_A_DATE_INPUT_EVENTS_DESCRIPTION_: The events open and close and the methods open(index = 0) and close().
_A_DATE_INPUT_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: label-position like the other form elements: "float", "inset" or "top". With several fields (range, date and time) the label is always on top. With a label in the field the format is below it.
